body:
We need to double check all latest news, question everything and reverify the actual state of things.

We should use references to lots of research papers, and prefer to base our conclusions in consensus established by multiple papers from different countries that reproduce same or similar results/conclusions.

We should note treat any single paper without multiple confirmations by other researchers as likely outcome.

We also need to set default configuration for UI/UX at https://konard.github.io/immortality/#ui=%7B%22palette%22%3A%22poseidon%22%2C%22glow%22%3A%22medium%22%2C%22surface%22%3A%22transparent%22%2C%22density%22%3A%22spacious%22%2C%22meter%22%3A%22segmented%22%2C%22font%22%3A%22orbitron%22%2C%22textEffect%22%3A%22sequence%22%2C%22background%22%3A%22perspective-grid%22%2C%22statusBar%22%3Atrue%2C%22intro%22%3A%22boot%22%2C%22chartStyle%22%3A%22area%22%2C%22chartGrid%22%3A%22dashed%22%2C%22entrance%22%3A%22scan%22%2C%22stagger%22%3Atrue%7D

The glass and flat transparency (or transparency of any material should be configured), more materials like wood, steel and others should be added.

All UI elements should be fully styled and fully integrated into skins and UI/UX configuration. For example drop down lists now don't look the same as the UI/UX, and data table also is not looking up to the style (for example its scroll bar) and so on.

We also need to add more high fidelity sounds that sound perfectly, and we should have multiple sounds per action to be configurable, sounds should not be named to actions they represent.

And if anything else we missing in configuration we should make UI/UX configuration much more detailes, so there more options to configure and choose from. Quality of backgrounds and gradients especially can be increased.

Double check UI ideas and elements we didn't recreate from all our references previously.

Also I think it is bad idea to have sections, which contain only expandable elements, it is better to have full content of the sections in that case.

Also come configurations for borders and panels look glitchy, not perfect, double check how they look, and how it was intentended. Some effects like full screen fog does glitch by appearing and disappearing and so on.

Double check the artistic ideas are migrated nicely and perfectly.

We need to collect data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), list of each and all requirements from the issue, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions).

Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
title: Double check correctness of all conclusions about immortality
